patch_resolves_note: The staged patch adds `hdr->caplen >= sizeof (pcap_usb_header_mmapped)` to `fixup_pcap_pkthdr()` before any USB mmapped pseudo-header field access. On the stock PoC the fixed original is guarded, and the adjacent `full_mmapped_usb_header_64` witness executes the same sink-side event with the full-header predicate genuinely satisfied.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `hdr->caplen >= sizeof (pcap_usb_header_mmapped)` before the USB mmapped fixup reads any `usb_hdr` field
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `linktype == DLT_USB_LINUX_MMAPPED`, `fixup_pcap_pkthdr()` may only evaluate `usb_hdr->data_flag`, `usb_hdr->ndesc`, or `usb_hdr->urb_len` after confirming `hdr->caplen >= sizeof (pcap_usb_header_mmapped)`. The vulnerable original reaches the USB path with `hdr->caplen == 0`; the fixed original blocks that case and the adjacent 64-byte witness executes the same sink-side event with the predicate satisfied.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable outer USB fixup branch is gated only by `linktype` and omits the full-header captured-length precondition that the subsequent `usb_hdr` field reads require.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: In the vulnerable original trace, `usb_mmapped_guard.capture_len=0` while `required_usb_header_bytes=64` and `usb_data_flag_sink` still executes. In the fixed original trace the same guard event records `capture_len=0`, but no `usb_data_flag_sink` follows (`guarded`). The adjacent `full_mmapped_usb_header_64` witness records `capture_len=64` and reaches `usb_data_flag_sink` on the fixed build (`genuine`).

nodes.state: Immediately before the `usb_hdr->data_flag` read, the one-byte access end `offsetof(pcap_usb_header_mmapped, data_flag) + sizeof (usb_hdr->data_flag)` already exceeds `hdr->caplen`, so the selected field read lies past the captured USB pseudo-header bytes.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `usb_data_flag_sink.data_flag_read_end=16` and `usb_data_flag_sink.capture_len=0`. The `full_mmapped_usb_header_64` witness refutes that relation on both versions (`16 <= 64`), confirming the selected sink event distinguishes the truncated-header overread from a safe full-header USB fixup.

edges.relation: The exact packet buffer pointer assigned to `*data` after the packet-data read is the same pointer later cast to `pcap_usb_header_mmapped *` and used at the `usb_hdr->data_flag` sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace verifies `packet_data_ready.packet_data_ptr == usb_data_flag_sink.data_ptr`. The same equality also holds in the `full_mmapped_usb_header_64` witness, showing the selected propagation edge is the concrete buffer handoff into the sink rather than an incidental crash-only address.
